messages:
Maria (Demand Gen): Heads-up — this morning we had ~120 MQLs come in during the 9:15-9:45 spike and ~18% didn't get assigned within our 2m SLA. HubSpot handoff logs show enrichment webhook timeouts. @Tom L can you look? :eyes:

Tom L (Growth Eng): seeing the same in logs, enrichment worker timed out on external enrichment at 503. Round-robin job retried but claim timeout expired.

Anika S (Sales Ops): that's bad — reps missed a bunch. Which workflow did it hit? Any rule mis-sync with SF mapping?

Tom L (Growth Eng): HubSpot workflow ID 4567 — we fallback to 'default_owner' when enrichment fails, but our default-owner rule has a mapping gap for EMEA leads; they landed in the unassigned pool.

Ryan G (Revenue): Can we do a quick mitigation? Maybe a temporary 'hot lane' for leads with score >=80 to bypass enrichment and assign immediate owner.

Tom L (Growth Eng): yep we can add a quick workflow: if mql_score >= 80 -> set owner = round_robin_owner. Patch below I can apply now:
```
workflow.modify(4567) {
  if (lead.mql_score >= 80 && lead.status == 'MQL') {
    set field 'owner' = round_robin_owner()
    skip enrichment
  }
}
```

Anika S (Sales Ops): please also add a heartbeat probe so we can detect enrichment stalls — 30s timeout -> alert to #support-ops. We need metrics for missed handoffs.

Ops SRE: adding heartbeat alert now. Probe: call /hs/enrich/health every 20s, alert if 5 consecutive failures. Will also add a temporary autoscale policy for enrichment worker.

Tom L (Growth Eng): rolled the hot-lane change at 10:03; also increased enrichment worker replicas by +2. HubSpot logs show 200s resends starting to succeed.

Maria (Demand Gen): awesome. Can we get a quick postmortem doc? Who owns the permanent fix (default-owner mapping + better retry/backoff + fallback assign)?

Tom L (Growth Eng): I'll own the mapping patch and better retry logic. Plan: (1) backfill default-owner mapping for all regions, (2) change claim timeout from 90s->180s, (3) add distributed lock so RR job doesn't skip owners during partial failures. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Anika S (Sales Ops): I'll coordinate rep communications and set a short-term rep notification CSV for any leads that were unassigned during the window.

Ryan G (Revenue): thanks team. Maria — can you add a blurb for marketing launch readiness note? We should avoid similar spikes during campaign launches.

Maria (Demand Gen): will do. Closing the loop: follow-up sync 11:30. :thumbsup:
